conflicts.fact: P(full seat/occupied) and the source of the 'filled' probability used for tree diagrams: Lessons 1, 2, 6 and 8 use 8/20 = 0.4 as the probability of a full bus; Lessons 4 and 7 use 10/14 ≈ 0.71 (7/10) as the probability a seat is filled, claimed to come from the tally
conflicts.versions: L1/L2/L8: P(full bus)=8/20=0.4; L6 tree: P(Full)=2/5 per trip; L7: P(Filled)=7/10 at each stop, 'estimated from the 20-trip data' as 10/14; L4: theoretical P(seat occupied)=10/14, yet 10/14 does not follow from the tally or a sample space of 14 seats

conflicts.fact: Whether Lesson 1 included a dice-rolling experiment
conflicts.versions: L1: only a coin-toss experiment (10-shilling coin) and Kamau's tally; L4: uses 'the Lesson 1 dice-rolling experiment results posted on the board' for P(sum=7)

conflicts.fact: Coin used and number of tosses per pair
conflicts.versions: L1: 10-shilling coin, 30 tosses per pair; L6: 5-shilling coin, 20 trials (40 tosses) per pair; L6 also says '20 trials per pair' vs '40-toss' experiment and ~160 pooled trials for a class of 40 (20 pairs x 20 = 400)

conflicts.fact: Addition law example with Kamau's data is arithmetically inconsistent with the dataset
conflicts.versions: L5: P(fully booked OR fewer than 7) = 8/20 + 2/20 = 1/2, but 10/20 = 1/2 is correct only if 2 trips had fewer than 7 passengers (6 and 6 =2, ok), whereas L2 uses 'fewer than 8' = 4/20 = 0.2 — but the tally has only 6,6,7 below 8 (3 trips), so 4/20 is wrong

conflicts.fact: Location of the dice game stall/context and Kamau's route stops
